ideas.title: Above You: the aircraft around you, live
ideas.body: On the ground, see the planes and helicopters flying around you right now: a list, a map with a radar, and which way your phone is facing so you know where to look. Tap one for its type, height, distance and a photo.

ideas.title: Point your phone at the sky
ideas.body: Hold your phone up and the aircraft above you are labelled on the camera picture, each with a little plane or helicopter pointing the way it flies, in your color theme.

ideas.title: Follow a plane
ideas.body: Pick a plane and follow it on the map, on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with a tap on your wrist when it's close.

ideas.title: Above You widgets
ideas.body: The aircraft around you on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, with a small radar. Page through them with the up and down buttons.

ideas.title: AirReveal on Apple Watch
ideas.body: The Above You radar, the plane you're following and your own flight, on your wrist.

ideas.title: Spotter's Logbook
ideas.body: Every aircraft you've revealed, kept on your phone, with your firsts, your rarest finds and your personal bests.

ideas.title: Games for spotters
ideas.body: Sky Bingo, three daily challenges, rare and legendary aircraft, trivia on each aircraft and new achievements. Turn any of them off in Settings › Games.

ideas.title: Split-Flap and Information Board skins
ideas.body: Make AirReveal look like an airport departures board. Choose a skin in Settings › Appearance, and pick its color in Color Theme.

ideas.title: A day map and a night map
ideas.body: The map is light by day and dark at night, by itself. You can still choose your own in the map options.

ideas.title: Easier to read and to use with VoiceOver
ideas.body: Clearer text and buttons that are easier to tap, and VoiceOver reads boards and flags as words.
